# Journal (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Journal` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-journal) | `GET /journal?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&TaskID={TaskID}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}` |
| [POST](#post-journal) | `POST /journal` |
| [PUT](#put-journal) | `PUT /journal` |
| [DELETE](#delete-journal) | `DELETE /journal?ID={ID}&Void={Void}` |


## Journal

Path: `/journal`

### Available fields for Journal
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |Yes*|  Unique ID. Required for PUT       |
| `Status`  | String           |         |    Yes      |Journal Status. Available values are `DRAFT`, `COMPLETED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `JournalNumber`  | String           |         |          |Journal Number. Read-only.        |
| `Currency`  | String           |         |    Yes  |Currency code.        |
| `CurrencyConversionRate` | Decimal |     |       Yes   | Conversion rate between tenant currency and `Currency` currency.|
| `EffectiveDate`  | DateTime           |         |       Yes   |Effective Date. |
| `Narration`  | String           |         |          |Narration        |
| `Notes`  | String           |         |          |Notes        |
|`Lines`|<a href="#JournalLineModel"><b>[] Journal Line Model</b></a>||||
|`Attachments`|<a href="#AttachmentLineModel"><b>[] Attachment Line Model</b></a>||||

<a id="get-journal"></a>
### GET /journal?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&TaskID={TaskID}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100. (Default: 100)
- `TaskID` (optional): Returns detailed info of a particular Journal
- `Status` (optional): "Only return Journals with specified status (Default: null)
- `Search` (optional): Only return Journals with search value contained in one of these fields: JournalNumber, Status, Narration, Notes (Default: null)

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 5,
  "Page": 1,
  "Journals": [
    {
      "TaskID": "1c6887f3-f7f2-4dbe-8f09-4903739f9175",
      "Status": "COMPLETED",
      "JournalNumber": "JR-00001",
      "Currency": "TOP",
      "CurrencyConversionRate": 25.2803,
      "EffectiveDate": "2018-01-19T00:00:00",
      "Narration": "Test",
      "Notes": "Test 1",
      "Lines": [
        {
          "Debit": "260",
          "Credit": "270",
          "Reference": "3",
          "Amount": 2,
          "BaseAmount": 50.5606
        }
      ],
      "Attachments": [
        {
          "ID": "8a720cdd-7871-42bb-8bfe-13cf6ea162a5",
          "ContentType": "image/jpeg",
          "FileName": "1471081716149.jpg",
          "DownloadUrl": "https://inventory.dearsystems.com/Attachment/Download?ID=8a720cdd-7871-42bb-8bfe-13cf6ea162a5&ContentType=image/jpeg&FileName=1471081716149.jpg"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="delete-journal"></a>
### DELETE /journal?ID={ID}&Void={Void}

Parameters:
- `ID` (required): ID of Jorunal to Void or Undo
- `Void` (optional,boolean): Void or Undo Jorunal
  - default: false

Response 200:
